notes: kb/Work PB201 (2026-09-04). REJECTED side: DataBinder.Odo screens data-name-1 as Category Numeric, IsFloat false, Scale 0 and raises COBOL0852 otherwise - a PIC 9V9 control item is rejected at every edition (pb201-odo-depending-not-integer; OCCURS DEPENDING is COBOL-85 and rule 17 has no introduction axis). ACCEPTED side: rule 17 asks for an INTEGER and nothing narrower, so a 20-digit COMP item and an unsigned BINARY-DOUBLE are both legal control items; pb201_odo_count_carriers exercises both and asserts the 13.18.38.4 GR8a current-count part each one sends. That golden is what proved the SECOND emitter of the position-carrier defect: RuntimeApi.PositionRead renders the current-count read at CODEGEN time from a Place and cannot decline a carrier and re-route the way the subscript renderer can, so MOVE <odo-group> TO X failed the backend with four CS1503s (System.Int128 and ulong to long) in the DEFAULT strict lane. Rule 17 is exactly what bounds that emitter's carrier universe to long/Int128/ulong/UInt128 plus the promoted string image - all five of which CobolPosition<PositionUse.Subscript>.Read now declares a parameter for - which is why the rejection has its own negative golden rather than resting on the accept side. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Odo.cs#OdoResolve (the pass body moved from the DataBinder partial to its own IBindPass class under Binding/Passes (kb/Work PB2352, PB2353, PB2354)) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Values/Tables/CobolTable.cs#Occ (kb/Work PB2645: the subscript and reference-modification position reads were unified into the one CobolPosition<TUse> read (CobolPosition.cs); the CobolTable/CobolString twins are deleted) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/CodeGen/Roslyn/RuntimeApi.cs#TableOcc (kb/Work PB2645: the position read is one CobolPosition<TUse>; the twin-specific emitter helper and drift-test arms are gone)
